title: Test running observation and value normalization separately
doing: Propose a2x2 ablation: current fixed scaling, observation normalization only, value normalization only, both. Keep masks/type IDs/padding semantics, training-only statistics, evaluation freezing and checkpointed normalizer state explicit. Define original reward/value units and affine value-output compensation; do not confuse existing LayerNorm or fixed reward scaling with running normalization. At least2 training seeds per cell; no launch.
expected: Running feature scales or normalized critic targets may improve stability, but already hand-scaled features and valid LayerNorm may leave little benefit. Statistics drift, output discontinuity or changed actor/value gradient balance can hurt; direction is uncertain and must be measured per component.

evidence.label: User-directed literature checklist handoff; papers are priors, not Dodge results
